display.purpose: DM Serif Display, page and hero titles only.

title.purpose: DM Mono 600, card titles and control labels.

body.purpose: DM Mono 400, paragraphs and dense content, 65-75ch.

label.purpose: DM Mono 600, uppercase meta and table headers.

shadows.name: soft-sm
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on cards, banners, and buttons.

shadows.name: soft-md
shadows.purpose: Raised interactive elements and active button context.

shadows.name: soft-lg
shadows.purpose: Modals and drawers, the only truly-lifted surfaces.

motion.name: lift-hover
motion.purpose: Soft hover lift on interactive surfaces; settles to translateY(0) on press. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Neutral graphite primary action with a soft hover lift. Deliberately not accent-coloured.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--app-text, oklch(0.9496 0.0096 273.35)); color: var(--app-text-inverse, oklch(0.2242 0.0137 278.83)); font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; font-size: 0.9375rem; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.34), 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent, oklch(0.809 0.105 251.813)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default panel surface, one tonal step above the page, hairline border, flat at rest with an optional soft lift.
components.html:
MAT 1320
Calculus I. Three hours of lecture, one hour of tutorial.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--app-surface, oklch(0.2668 0.0186 294.27)); color: var(--app-text, oklch(0.9496 0.0096 273.35)); border: 1px solid var(--app-border, oklch(0.2837 0.0201 293.41)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--app-text-muted, oklch(0.7654 0.0232 274.64)); } .ds-soft-lift { transition: transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; will-change: transform; } .ds-soft-lift:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-soft-lift:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sunken field with a strong hairline that shifts to the accent focus ring on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search a course or professor" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--app-surface, oklch(0.2668 0.0186 294.27)); color: var(--app-text, oklch(0.9496 0.0096 273.35)); font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; border: 1px solid var(--app-border-strong, oklch(0.3604 0.0258 291.16)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--app-text-dim, oklch(0.6454 0.0375 278.13)); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--app-accent, oklch(0.809 0.105 251.813)); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped meta chip on the overlay surface. Mono, weight 600, no uppercase transform.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--app-surface-overlay, oklch(0.3003 0.0216 292.69)); color: var(--app-text, oklch(0.9496 0.0096 273.35)); font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; font-size: 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; }

components.name: Accent Checkbox
components.description: One of the few controls that carries the theme accent: checked state fills with the accent while buttons stay neutral.
components.html: <label class="ds-check-row"><input class="ds-check" type="checkbox" checked /> Avoid mornings before 10am</label>
components.css: .ds-check-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--app-text, oklch(0.9496 0.0096 273.35)); } .ds-check { appearance: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--app-border-strong, oklch(0.3604 0.0258 291.16)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--app-surface-overlay, oklch(0.3003 0.0216 292.69)); display: inline-grid; place-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-check:checked { background: var(--app-accent, oklch(0.809 0.105 251.813)); border-color: var(--app-accent, oklch(0.809 0.105 251.813)); } .ds-check:checked::after { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; clip-path: polygon(14% 44%, 0 65%, 40% 100%, 100% 16%, 82% 0, 38% 68%); background: var(--app-on-accent, oklch(0.2217 0.0412 259.27)); }

components.name: Calendar Event
components.description: Signature WeekCalendar block: course hue mixed with the surface, with legible on-event text.
components.css: .ds-event { --course: oklch(0.74 0.1 252); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--course) 38%, var(--app-bg, oklch(0.2216 0.0117 293.07))); color: var(--app-on-event, oklch(0.9588 0.0045 78.3)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-event-code { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-event-meta { font-size: 0.6875rem; opacity: 0.85; }

narrative.overview: uoplan is the calm, competent tool a uOttawa student reaches for at 11pm the week registration opens. The whole system is built around one physical scene: a focused student at a dark desk, reading a schedule, wanting the timetable to appear and the anxiety to leave. The canvas is a warm violet-charcoal, the content is light, and nothing on screen competes for attention it hasn't earned. The signature move is typographic contrast: DM Serif Display for headings gives every screen an editorial confidence, while DM Mono carries all body and UI text with the quiet precision of a terminal. Colour is deliberately scarce, one pastel accent shows up only where interaction lives, and depth comes from soft diffuse shadows and a two-pixel lift, never hard outlines or stacked cards. It is not uoCampus or Brightspace, and it is not a generic SaaS dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, warm-neutral canvas; light content on a violet-charcoal surface.
Editorial serif headings over a monospace body; structural contrast without extra colour.
One accent, used sparingly, applied to interactive controls rather than sprayed across the page.
Soft diffuse elevation and a subtle hover lift; flat and quiet at rest.
Dense information, low visual noise. Every element earns its place.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one interactive accent (sky blue on dark, a darker blue on light, garnet on Gee-Gees). It marks where interaction lives and appears on a small fraction of any screen. Never introduce a second decorative accent.

rules.name: The Neutral-Button Rule
rules.body: Buttons deliberately do not use the accent. Mantine's primaryColor is a near-neutral constructBlack; the accent is wired per-control via CSS variables. Primary actions read as confident graphite, not coloured chrome.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure black or white. Every neutral is tinted toward the active theme's hue at low chroma.

rules.name: The Serif-Headline Rule
rules.body: Headings are serif (DM Serif Display) and body is monospace (DM Mono), always. The face contrast is the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Single-Weight Display Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display ships at weight 400 only. Scale, not weight, differentiates serif headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and gain shadow only as a response to state. Interactive cards use .soft-lift, translating translateY(-2px) with a soft shadow on hover, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do author every colour in OKLCH and reference it through an --app-* token. Never hardcode a hex value.
Do keep DM Serif Display for headings and DM Mono for body/UI text; let face contrast carry hierarchy.
Do keep the accent rare, on interactive controls and focus states, on a small fraction of any screen.
Do separate surfaces with tonal layering plus 1px hairlines first; reach for shadow only on state change.
Do cap body measure at 65-75ch and respect prefers-reduced-motion on every lift and transition.
Do keep primary buttons neutral graphite; wire the accent per-control via CSS variables.
donts: Don't make it look like uoCampus or Brightspace: boxy, dated, institutional, hard outlines everywhere.
Don't ship generic SaaS dashboard patterns: hero-metric templates, gradient cards, confetti illustrations.
Don't use #000 or #fff, or any untinted neutral.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) or border-left/border-right colour stripes as accents.
Don't nest cards inside cards, or wrap content in a container that doesn't need one.
Don't add a second decorative accent colour or restyle a heading to the mono face.
Don't use hard offset stamp shadows; the system moved to soft diffuse elevation on purpose.
Don't add confirmation dialogs for non-destructive actions; speed over ceremony.
